name: Canvas export (PDF/DOCX/Markdown)
ui_location: Canvas panel -> Download dropdown trigger (button#radix-_r_*_, aria-label='Download') -> format menuitem.
recipe: From an open Canvas (see chatgpt-canvas).

Use the mandated CDP artifact-click pattern: node dist/src/cli.js browser:artifact-click --profile chatgpt --tab-url-contains "/c/<convId>" --button-selector '<download-dropdown-id>' --follow-up-text-regex 'Markdown Document' --download-dir <abs> --output-json
Dropdown exposes exactly 3 menuitems: 'PDF Document (.pdf)', 'Microsoft Word Document (.docx)', 'Markdown Document (.md)'.

The download-dropdown-id is a dynamic Radix id (#radix-_r_*_); locate it each run by aria-label='Download' on the canvas toolbar (it is the Download button that has aria-haspopup; the other plain 'Download' button is the chat-turn one).
completion_gate: browser:artifact-click returns {path, sha256, size, suggestedFilename, downloadGuid}.
evidence:
Exercised live end-to-end via browser:artifact-click (follow-up-text-regex 'Markdown Document'); file content verified ('# Stream5 Canvas Probe
one
two
three
four').
notes: This is a single-call artifact path via the mandated CDP pattern (unlike stream4's canvas-download-dropdown which was flagged as multi-step — the --follow-up-text-regex form resolves it). PDF/DOCX should work identically with regex 'PDF Document' / 'Microsoft Word Document'.
